title: Shivel Sanctuary
description:
Kick back and relax in this peaceful, charming home.   All modern amenities and walkable to many conveniences.  Large kitchen, laundry room, serene backyard and off street parking.  Come and enjoy sunshine from your deck as you enter into all that Hendersonville and nearby Nashville have to offer. The Haven provides two desk areas for those who plan to work while enjoying the area.

The space
The beautiful charm of a completely renovated older home is the perfect description of Home Sweet Haven.   Complete with two hang out spaces, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms,  a fully stocked kitchen,  laundry room, and outdoor space. There is something for everyone!

Guest access
Every part of our home is fully accessible to all guests.  Please make yourself at home during your stay.

Other things to note
You have many choices . . . thank you for choosing to stay with us.  We want your experience to be exceptional.
